This holding runs ONE ROSTER. A name moves between delivery and the rota inside a fortnight, and has forty-one times this year. At this level they are fungible and therefore one layer, and the group's coupling has no upper counterpart — it is absorbed, not refuted. ⚠️ The honest argument against this fusion is in the layer above: the parts disagree on `timeSlack`, so the fused figure is unsized, which means some of this demand survives a queue and some of it perishes on contact. A reader who thinks that makes them two layers is disagreeing with the roster, not with the arithmetic.

asrt:fusion.asrt:observed:
the group could not join these two and was right not to: `compute-us` is billed per reserved card and `compute-pt` by the month, and `4.4 GPU + 545 GPU-hour` is not a sum. It filed two one-part fusions under two names, which is exactly what that shape is for, and stopped there because it had no way to say how one becomes the other.
This holding meters both in card-hours for its own capacity planning, and a card reserved in Texas and an hour bought in Lisbon serve the same inference queue: work moves between them within a day, so they hold no remainder independently and they are one layer.
⛔⛔ AND THIS FUSION ABSORBS A FILED COUPLING, WHICH IT OWES A REASON FOR. The group observed that US inference above the reserved eight cards is routed to the Lisbon reservation, so the Portuguese layer's clearance falls when the US layer's demand peaks, and filed it as a `pm:Coupling` between two layers it could not join. That observation is not evidence for this fusion — coupling and fungibility are independent axes, and the group filed the same coupling shape between `labour` and `shift-line`, which are emphatically not one layer. What makes these two one layer is the metering. ⭐ The coupling does not survive as a coupling and it does not vanish either: THE ROUTED HOURS ARE THE ELIMINATION BELOW. A peer-to-peer observation between two layers became a double-count inside one, which is what absorbing a coupling means when the thing it described was traffic rather than sympathy.
⚠️ WHAT A READER SHOULD DISAGREE WITH IS THE FACTOR, NOT THE FUSION. A reserved card is available every hour of the month and a purchased hour is not, so whether eight cards really deliver [5376, 5760, 5952] usable card-hours is a claim about utilisation that this filing does not separate out. It is stated where it can be argued with rather than performed silently in a spreadsheet, which is the whole reason this element exists.
